shortDescription: Manage protection groups on Everpure FlashArrays

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: enabled
options.description: Define whether to enabled snapshots for the protection group.

options.name: eradicate
options.description: Define whether to eradicate the protection group on delete and leave in trash.

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: host
options.description: List of existing hosts to add to protection group. Note that hostnames are case-sensitive however FlashArray hostnames are unique and ignore case - you cannot have I(hosta) and I(hostA)

options.name: hostgroup
options.description: List of existing hostgroups to add to protection group. Note that hostgroups are case-sensitive however FlashArray hostgroup names are unique and ignore case - you cannot have I(groupa) and I(groupA)

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the protection group.

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: rename
options.description: Rename a protection group If the source protection group is in a Pod or Volume Group 'container' you only need to provide the new protection group name in the same 'container'

options.name: safe_mode
options.description: Enables SafeMode restrictions on the protection group B(Once set disabling this can only be performed by Pure Technical Support)

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the protection group should exist or not. If specified with I(volume) or I(host) or I(hostgroup) will act on those items in the protection group only.

options.name: target
options.description: List of remote arrays or offload target for replication protection group to connect to. Note that all replicated protection groups are asynchronous. Target arrays or offload targets must already be connected to the source array. Maximum number of targets per Portection Group is 4, assuming your configuration supports this.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: volume
options.description: List of existing volumes to add to protection group. Note that volume are case-sensitive however FlashArray volume names are unique and ignore case - you cannot have I(volumea) and I(volumeA)
